layout.footer: You receive this message because you are a stakeholder of {application_name}. Manage your subscriptions with the application team in Keigan.
layout.automated: This message was generated automatically by Keigan. Please verify critical facts with the incident record.

cause_identified.label: Cause identified
cause_identified.sentence: Keigan identified the most likely cause.

inconclusive.label: Inconclusive
inconclusive.sentence: The cause is not confirmed: the evidence does not settle between the explanations.

cause_not_visible.label: Cause not visible
cause_not_visible.sentence: Keigan could not see the cause in the monitoring data it can read. The team is investigating.

email.could_not_check: Keigan could not check {count} source(s); see the investigation.

incident_detected.subject: [{priority}] Incident detected: {title}
incident_detected.headline: Incident detected
incident_detected.intro: Keigan detected a new incident in {application_name} and has started investigating.

preliminary_report.subject: [{priority}] Preliminary report: {title}
preliminary_report.headline: Preliminary investigation report
preliminary_report.intro: Keigan finished its first investigation of this incident. The findings are preliminary and may change.

progress_update.subject: [{priority}] Update: {title}
progress_update.headline: Incident update
progress_update.intro: An update on the incident in {application_name}.

resolution_update.subject: [{priority}] Resolved: {title}
resolution_update.headline: Incident resolved
resolution_update.intro: The incident in {application_name} has been resolved.

executive_summary.subject: [{priority}] Executive summary: {title}
executive_summary.headline: Executive summary
executive_summary.intro: A short summary for leadership about the incident in {application_name}.

postmortem.subject: Postmortem: {title}
postmortem.headline: Postmortem report
postmortem.intro: The postmortem for the incident in {application_name} is ready.

slo_burn_alert.subject: [{severity}] SLO burn alert: {title}
slo_burn_alert.headline: SLO error budget is burning fast
slo_burn_alert.intro: The error budget of an SLO in {application_name} is being consumed faster than planned.

test.subject: Keigan test notification for {application_name}
test.headline: Test notification
test.intro: This is a test message so you can confirm that Keigan notifications reach you.

team_invitation.subject: You were added to {application_name} in Keigan
team_invitation.headline: You are on the team
team_invitation.intro: You were added to the team of {application_name} in Keigan, which gathers evidence and explains incidents for the application.
team_invitation.access_note: To open the application you need access through the group {reader_group}. If you cannot open it, request that group (or {admin_group} to change settings) in SailPoint. Keigan does not grant access itself.

chat.welcome: I am Keigan. I will post investigation findings here and learn from your discussion. Ask me with "Keigan, ...". Say "Keigan, this is finished" when the incident is done and I will prepare the postmortem.
chat.milestone_ack: Understood. I am generating the postmortem draft now; it will appear in Keigan shortly.
chat.no_answer: I could not answer that right now. Open the investigation in Keigan for the full findings.
chat.unverified_notice: This answer does not point to any tool result. Treat it as unverified.

fallbacks.resetTime: the start of the next UTC day
fallbacks.reason: Keigan cannot answer this from the logs. Try asking about the requests, errors or latency of a service.

ai_timeout.title: The AI model took too long
ai_timeout.detail: The AI model ({modelTier}) did not answer in {seconds} seconds. Nothing was changed. If this repeats, ask an admin to check the AI endpoint.

ai_rate_limited.title: The AI model is busy
ai_rate_limited.detail: The AI model is busy right now. Try again in {retryAfterSeconds} seconds.

ai_authentication_failed.title: Keigan could not sign in to the AI model
ai_authentication_failed.detail: Keigan could not sign in to the AI model. This needs an admin: check the AI model credentials.

ai_unavailable.title: The AI model could not be reached
ai_unavailable.detail: The AI model could not be reached. Try again shortly.

ai_tools_unsupported.title: The AI model cannot use tools
ai_tools_unsupported.detail: The configured AI model ({modelTier}) cannot use tools, which Ask Keigan needs. Ask a Keigan admin to change the AI model settings.

ai_tool_protocol_failed.title: The AI model did not follow the tool format
ai_tool_protocol_failed.detail: The AI model ({modelTier}) did not follow the tool format twice, so Keigan stopped instead of guessing. Try again; if it repeats, an admin should check the model.

ai_output_invalid.title: The AI model returned an unusable answer
ai_output_invalid.detail: The AI model ({modelTier}) returned an answer Keigan could not use, so Keigan stopped instead of guessing. Try again; if it repeats, an admin should check the model.

ai_request_rejected.title: The AI model rejected the request
ai_request_rejected.detail: The AI model ({modelTier}) rejected the request, so Keigan stopped. Try again; if it repeats, an admin should check the AI model settings.

token_budget_exceeded.title: The daily AI budget is used up
token_budget_exceeded.detail: The daily AI budget for {budgetOwner} is used up. It resets at {resetTime}.

rate_limited.title: You are asking too quickly
rate_limited.detail: You are sending questions too quickly. Try again in {retryAfterSeconds} seconds.

answer_in_progress.title: Keigan is still answering
answer_in_progress.detail: Keigan is still answering your previous question in this conversation. Wait for it to finish or stop it.

duplicate_request.title: Question already sent
duplicate_request.detail: This question was already sent, so the existing answer is shown.

forbidden.title: You do not have access
forbidden.detail: You can't read {applicationName}. Ask its admin for access.

access_lost_mid_run.title: Your access changed while Keigan was answering
access_lost_mid_run.detail: Your access to {applicationName} changed while Keigan was answering, so this answer was stopped. Ask an admin to check your access.

tool_failed_source_unavailable.title: Couldn't complete "{toolLabel}"
tool_failed_source_unavailable.detail: Couldn't complete "{toolLabel}": {sourceName} could not be reached. This result is missing from the answer.

tool_failed_timeout.title: Couldn't complete "{toolLabel}"
tool_failed_timeout.detail: Couldn't complete "{toolLabel}": it took longer than {seconds} seconds. Try a narrower question.

tool_failed_not_found.title: "{toolLabel}": not found
tool_failed_not_found.detail: "{toolLabel}": that {recordKind} was not found. Check the name and try again.

tool_query_not_answerable.title: Keigan cannot answer this from the logs

tool_output_invalid.title: Couldn't use the result of "{toolLabel}"
tool_output_invalid.detail: Couldn't use the result of "{toolLabel}". It is recorded for an admin.

tool_limit_reached.title: Stopped at the tool-call limit
tool_limit_reached.detail: Stopped at the limit of {maximum} tool calls. Keigan answered from what it had found; ask a follow-up to go further.

answer_interrupted.title: The answer was interrupted
answer_interrupted.detail: The answer was interrupted because Keigan restarted. Ask the question again; the steps it finished are shown above.

stream_interrupted.title: The connection was lost
stream_interrupted.detail: The connection was lost. Keigan is still answering; reconnecting...

internal_error.title: Unexpected error
internal_error.detail: Keigan hit an unexpected error while {stepDescription}. Reference {reference}. It has been logged.

tool_not_available.title: That tool is not available here
tool_not_available.detail: "{toolLabel}" is not available in this conversation.

not_found.title: Not found
not_found.detail: That {recordKind} was not found. It may have been removed.

authentication_required.title: Sign in again
authentication_required.detail: Your sign-in expired. Sign in again to keep using Keigan.

cancelled.title: Answer stopped
cancelled.detail: You stopped this answer. The steps Keigan finished are shown above.

answer_not_running.title: The answer already finished
answer_not_running.detail: That answer is no longer running, so there is nothing to stop.

ask_keigan_answers.no_access: You don't have access to any applications yet, so there is nothing for me to look at.
ask_keigan_answers.access_lost: You no longer have access to an application this answer used.
ask_keigan_answers.outside_scope: That is outside what I can answer from Keigan's data.

limit_reached.tool_limit: I stopped at the limit of {maximum} tool calls before I could write a full answer. This is what the checks found:
limit_reached.token_budget: I stopped at the token budget for one answer before I could write a full answer. This is what the checks found:
limit_reached.nothing_found: None of the checks returned anything I can report.
